1925, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 22
March 25 Consumption and Complication Cured. Robert Hitch non-Catholic 5816 Trumbul Ave. 24 with wife & 2 chil. Enrolled March 16. About to give up his work because of TB is enrolled by Catholic friend - consumptive and all kinds of complication. To-day re- ported entirely changed and in good health working steadily. Deo Gratias.
29 Bleeding Walter Rownski 2711 Edwin Ave. (Hamtramck) 17 bleeding kidney operated on and relieved of one kidney two years ago, now bleeding freely from other, is enrolled the day before pending operation and is found same evening in perfect condition
30 Mrs. Kathleen Garvin 35 yrs. 418 Continental, taken to St. Marys Hospital four days before 1st baby - March 1st - sickly for two months before. To-day 4 weeks, in hopless condition, is enrolled for 2nd time. What will be result? We will leave it to God in the holy Masses.
31 Property Sold Wm F. Young 2444 Hele Ave. Now 1338 Somerset Rd. Gross Pt. Pk. Trying two years to sell property is enrolled in S.M.A. March 20th - March 28th property is fortunately sold.
April 1st April Fool - Death Fooled To-day - Walice Murray, Bad Axe, Mich. 4.25 a.m. phone call - "Could I speak to Fr. S?" "This is Fr. S." "Well Fr: This is Miss Sullivan .... Miss Murray's Brother is just taken to the Receiving Hospital unconscious. The doctors have very lit hope. Will you please put him in the S.M.A. right away?" --- Wallice Murray is enrolled at 4.30 A.M. 8.30 P.M. reported 100% improved --- is up & around within week. Murry's sister Mary pro- missed too - $25.00 a month for three months if her brother were spared. - Terrible head aches now no more.
6th Ideal Position Obtained. John Wilkinson 21 - 2153 Waterloo St. out of work since before Xmas Enrolled April 1st, gets phone call April 5th to take position for which 217 had applied.
Gurter & Complication - Gall Trouble - Mary Chyba (28) 5203 Junc- tion, a hopless case not able to be around and too weak for oper- ation is enrolled to-day for 2 yrs.
14th Hopeless Case - Has Hopes Again. 2.30 p.m. Just received phone report from sister of Catherine Hartnett, Harper Hosp. that the latter is in very promising condition after attempted operation last Thur. Miss Hartnett declared absolutely hopeless by doctors who opened her abdomen and finding obstructions so complicated that in dispair they simply sewed her up and awaited death.
